正文开始，先接着开头再来讲解一下米哈游的游戏的丝袜渲染吧

## 原神

在上一篇文章中，其实初略的讲解过了原神的丝袜的针织效果，这次就以丝袜上的闪光效果来分析一下

在原神中，角色丝袜上的闪光效果大致能分为程序化闪光和贴图，而目前使用贴图来制作丝袜闪光的角色仅有丝柯克，其余大部分的角色丝袜闪光是程序化闪光，

![](data:image/png;base64,)

*<span style="font-size: 12px;">效果如图</span>*

要实现这个效果，我们要用hash函数来一个伪随机

首先是切分uv，在上一篇文章中我说要将uv切分800格，实测下来其实100格左右就行了

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float2</span> c1 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">floor</span>(uv \* scale);

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float2</span> f1 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">frac</span>(uv \* scale);

切分uv后就是用hash生成随机数了，在这用到的是hash33

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float3</span> h1 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">frac</span>(<span style="color: #569cd6;">float3</span>(c1, <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.0</span>) \* <span style="color: #569cd6;">float3</span>(<span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.1031</span>, <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.1030</span>, <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.0973</span>));

h1 += <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">dot</span>(h1, h1.yxz + <span style="color: #b5cea8;">33.33</span>);

h1 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">frac</span>((h1.xxy + h1.yxx) \* h1.zyx);

在这之后就是根据伪随机数来做闪光点了

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float2</span> d1 = f1 - h1.xy;

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> r1 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">max</span>(size \* (<span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.5</span> + <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.5</span> \* h1.z), 1e-<span style="color: #b5cea8;">5</span>);

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> s1 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">saturate</span>(<span style="color: #b5cea8;">1.0</span> - <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">dot</span>(d1, d1) / (r1 \* r1));

s1 \*= (<span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.5</span> + <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.5</span> \* <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">sin</span>(t \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">6.2831853</span> + h1.z \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">6.2831853</span>)) \* <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">step</span>(thr, h1.z);

做完这些就可以看到闪点的效果了，可以再叠加一层，完整代码如下

<span style="color: #6a9955;">//默认值</span>

<span style="color: #6a9955;">//scale ≈ 100 密度</span>

<span style="color: #6a9955;">//size &nbsp;= 0.05 星点大小</span>

<span style="color: #6a9955;">//thr &nbsp; = 0.5 阈值</span>

<span style="color: #6a9955;">//inten = 2.5 星点亮度</span>

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float2</span> uv = TEXCOORD1;

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> t  = Time;

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> scale;

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> size;

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> thr;

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> inten;

  

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float2</span> c1 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">floor</span>(uv \* scale);

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float2</span> f1 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">frac</span>(uv \* scale);

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float3</span> h1 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">frac</span>(<span style="color: #569cd6;">float3</span>(c1, <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.0</span>) \* <span style="color: #569cd6;">float3</span>(<span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.1031</span>, <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.1030</span>, <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.0973</span>));

h1 += <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">dot</span>(h1, h1.yxz + <span style="color: #b5cea8;">33.33</span>);

h1 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">frac</span>((h1.xxy + h1.yxx) \* h1.zyx);

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float2</span> d1 = f1 - h1.xy;

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> r1 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">max</span>(size \* (<span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.5</span> + <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.5</span> \* h1.z), 1e-<span style="color: #b5cea8;">5</span>);

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> s1 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">saturate</span>(<span style="color: #b5cea8;">1.0</span> - <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">dot</span>(d1, d1) / (r1 \* r1));

s1 \*= (<span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.5</span> + <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.5</span> \* <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">sin</span>(t \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">6.2831853</span> + h1.z \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">6.2831853</span>)) \* <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">step</span>(thr, h1.z);

  

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float2</span> c2 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">floor</span>(uv \* scale \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">2.17</span>);

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float2</span> f2 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">frac</span>(uv \* scale \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">2.17</span>);

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float3</span> h2 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">frac</span>(<span style="color: #569cd6;">float3</span>(c2, <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.0</span>) \* <span style="color: #569cd6;">float3</span>(<span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.1031</span>, <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.1030</span>, <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.0973</span>));

h2 += <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">dot</span>(h2, h2.yxz + <span style="color: #b5cea8;">33.33</span>);

h2 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">frac</span>((h2.xxy + h2.yxx) \* h2.zyx);

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float2</span> d2 = f2 - h2.xy;

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> r2 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">max</span>(size \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.6</span> \* (<span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.5</span> + <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.5</span> \* h2.z), 1e-<span style="color: #b5cea8;">5</span>);

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> s2 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">saturate</span>(<span style="color: #b5cea8;">1.0</span> - <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">dot</span>(d2, d2) / (r2 \* r2));

s2 \*= (<span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.5</span> + <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.5</span> \* <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">sin</span>(t \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">6.2831853</span> + <span style="color: #b5cea8;">1.7</span> + h2.z \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">6.2831853</span>)) \* <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">step</span>(thr \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">1.1</span>, h2.z);

  

<span style="color: #c586c0;">return</span> <span style="color: #569cd6;">float3</span>(<span style="color: #b5cea8;">1.0</span>, <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.97</span>, <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.92</span>) \* (s1 + s2) \* inten;

  

## 少前2

少前2的丝袜渲染是我根据实机效果主观还原的，没有深入了解其管线，使用AI简单分析了一下

“延迟 <span style="font-family: 微软雅黑; font-size: 10.5pt;"> GBuffer 写入法线/材质，Forward 阶段用 GGX 计算高光，再用 Toon Ramp 量化。竖向亮带来自圆柱 + 各向同性 GGX 峰值，而不是各向异性。”——deepseek v4.1 flash</span>
